CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_market_post_limit(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
select case when not exists(select 1 from auth.users u where u.id=p_user_id) then 0
 when exists(select 1 from public.user_memberships m where m.user_id=p_user_id and m.plan in ('basic','large','seller') and m.status not in ('canceled','expired') and m.paid_until>statement_timestamp()) then 30 else 5 end::integer;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_market_post_limit(p_user_id uuid)

 when public.is_user_membership_active(p_user_id) then 30 else 5 end::integer;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_user_membership_active(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
select p_user_id is not null and (
 public.is_app_admin(p_user_id) or exists(
 select 1 from public.user_memberships m
 where m.user_id=p_user_id and m.plan in ('basic','large','seller')
 and m.status not in ('canceled','expired')
 and m.paid_until>statement_timestamp()));
-- Plus/explicit administrator gate ONLY. Free cloud eligibility is separate.
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_user_membership_active(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
-- Paid qualification only. Administrative authority is checked independently.
select coalesce(p_user_id is not null and exists(
 select 1 from public.user_memberships m
 where m.user_id=p_user_id and m.plan in ('basic','large','seller')
   and m.paid_until>statement_timestamp()
   and (m.status='active' or
     (m.status='past_due' and exists(
       select 1 from public.membership_payments mp
       where mp.user_id=p_user_id
         and mp.plan in ('basic','large','seller') and mp.status='confirmed'
         and mp.service_started_at<=statement_timestamp()
         and mp.service_ends_at>statement_timestamp())))),false);
$function$
